facts.value: Sport is a hugely rewarding part of my life and I have always enjoyed an active lifestyle.
PE at UL offers practical experience in a great variety of sports and games, gymnastics, dance and aquatics.
The course provides key knowledge and teaching skills to apply in teaching and sporting contexts.
The course offers worthwhile and rewarding opportunities to teach and coach.
Opportunities include getting involved in community events, youth sport, or working with people with disabilities.
School placement is an integral part of the course and provides the opportunity to put knowledge and skills into practice.
The school placement experiences helped me to realize how much I enjoy teaching and enabled me to identify my own strengths.
I gained the best possible insight into what it’s like to teach PE and coach teams in schools today.
